summary: Tested fixed Finzo Coin referral rewards end to end. Backend: 8/8 pytest pass (test_iter12_coin_rewards_privacy.py). Registering a new user with demo.a's code B3D494B2 gives demo.a a friend_signup reward of +50 (5000 cents), credited to the referral_coins wallet and ledger. Completing the webinar three times gives the new user own_webinar +20 once and demo.a friend_webinar +50 once, with no duplicates. /team/members, /team/tree and /team/export contain no coin data, and names beyond generation 1 are masked. Admin /admin/coin-rewards lists rewards with search and totals. Settings update is validated (negative, non-integer and >100000 return 400), shows up in /coin-rewards amounts, and was restored to 50/50/20. Frontend: the landing ReferralBonus shows +50/+50/+20 FZC with no percentages or deposit wording. demo.a /app/coin-rewards shows a total of 100 and the history. The team table has exactly Name/Generation/Rank/Joined/Activity, and the tree has no coins. The admin coin rewards page loads, saves amounts with a toast, search works, and there is no horizontal overflow on mobile (390). Auth checks: bcrypt $2b$, httpOnly cookies, CORS not *.

ui_bugs.issue: On a user's first login the welcome-tour and pwa-install-dialog open at the same time and stack (two overlays). Not part of this feature, but poor first-run UX.

issues: Reward table scrolls horizontally inside its container; only Date/Earned by are visible at first. Acceptable but could use a card layout on mobile.

action_items: Optional: queue the PWA install prompt until after the welcome tour closes (it already dispatches a 'tour:done' event)
Optional: remove the now-unused coin_stats import/usage from team code paths if not needed (it is still used by /coin-rewards)
critical_code_review_comments: award_coins relies on the idem_key check in post_ledger (find then insert), and ledger_transactions.idem_key has no unique index. Webinar completion is protected by an atomic update_one/modified_count and register runs once per user, so the risk is low today. Add a unique sparse index on ledger_transactions.idem_key for defense in depth.
friend_webinar is awarded to the referrer even if the referrer is now suspended or deleted. Decide whether that is the intended business rule.
The register rate limit is 10 per IP per hour, which test suites registering several users can hit.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_coin_rewards.py (team assertions updated to the new privacy rule: no coins_earned/earned_by)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Set localStorage lang='en' before login to skip the language picker. After login, press Escape a few times to close the welcome-tour and pwa-install dialogs. Login submit testid: login-submit-btn. Coin amounts are stored in cents (x100). demo.a's coin total has grown with each run, so use deltas.
